nodes.text:
@WalesOnline Or rather, NHS is taken by surprise by predictable increase in seasonal conditions like flu, and struggles to cope despite record funding. So managers resort to gimmicks like facemasks.

And HMPV did not "first emerge in China". It has already been present globally for decades.
